titles.en: Qin Stone Drums, original set of ten

productionDate.original: 秦国遗物，确切年代未定

currentCollection.note: Catalogue holding; no current exhibition claim.
currentCollection.noteZh: 按机构著录记录收藏，不据此判断当前是否展出。

provenanceEvents.summary: A Palace Museum lecture account places the drums in the Jigugu Pavilion of Baohe Hall after their move to Bianliang during the Daguan era.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 故宫博物院讲座资料记，北宋大观年间，石鼓运至汴梁，收入保和殿稽古阁。

provenanceEvents.summary: In 1933 the original drums went south with objects from the Imperial Academy and other institutions. They returned after the war; the wider evacuation route is not a verified itinerary for the drums.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 1933 年，十面原石随国子监等处文物南迁；抗战胜利后运回。这里不把一般故宫南迁路线当作石鼓逐站行程。

review.note: Draft. One museum catalogue entry covers the set.
review.noteZh: 草稿。此条对应馆方整组著录。

notes: Reported general dimensions are not individual drum measurements.
notesZh: 馆方概述尺寸不作为逐鼓实测值。
